required_unknowns: No universal numerical diffraction limit answers every optical measurement task.
A localization-precision result does not by itself establish structural resolution.
Calibration performance transfers only within its declared modality, sample, and processing scope.
Future empirical performance of TraceRes remains unobserved.
required_human_review_items: Verify source metadata against publisher pages when the requested browser is available.
Approve any future microscope, illumination, live-cell, fluorophore, sample, or data-permission plan.
Review public language for scope, artifact alternatives, and unsupported structural claims.
writing_constraints: Write in English and IEEE conference style.
Do not include acknowledgement, funding, author biography, or personal-note sections.
Do not report microscopy acquisition, benchmark performance, observed biological structure, or a completed super-resolution result.
State the physical and methodological conclusions directly within evidence scope.
Use only registered source keys and distinguish conventional diffraction, localization precision, and structural resolution.
